metadata.question: In areas across the northeastern Pacific Ocean, were sea surface temperatures cooler in August 2019 than the average for the same month from 1985-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need sea surface temperature (SST) data - Two time periods: August 2019 vs. August 1985-2012 average - Location: Northeastern Pacific Ocean (roughly 30°N-60°N, 180°W-120°W) - Will use NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1 (daily SST dataset) 2. Masking strategy: - SST data quality flags should be checked - No cloud masking needed (ocean data) - Focus on valid SST measurements 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid SST values should be in reasonable range (e.g., -2°C to 35°C) - Compare August 2019 mean vs. 1985-2012 August mean - If either is null/NaN → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If no valid pixels → C2 - If 2019 < historical average → A (Yes, cooler) - If 2019 >= historical average → B (No, not cooler) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define northeastern Pacific Ocean region const nePacific = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, 30], [-120, 30], [-120, 60], [-180, 60], [-180, 30]] ]); // 2. Load SST data for August 2019 const sst2019 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate('2019-08-01', '2019-09-01') .filterBounds(nePacific) .select('sst'); const count2019 = sst2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2019 images: ${count2019}`); if (count2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Load SST data for August 1985-2012 const sstHistorical = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1985, 2012, 'year')) .filterBounds(nePacific) .select('sst'); const countHistorical = sstHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 1985-2012 images: ${countHistorical}`); if (countHistorical === 0) { console.log('No historical data for August 1985-2012.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean SST for both periods const mean2019 = sst2019.mean(); const meanHistorical = sstHistorical.mean(); // 5. Get regional statistics const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nePacific, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsHistorical = meanHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nePacific, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sst2019Mean = stats2019.sst_mean; const sst2019Count = stats2019.sst_count; const sstHistMean = statsHistorical.sst_mean; const sstHistCount = statsHistorical.sst_count; console.log(`2019 Mean SST: ${sst2019Mean ? sst2019Mean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${sst2019Count || 0}`); console.log(`1985-2012 Mean SST: ${sstHistMean ? sstHistMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${sstHistCount || 0}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (!sst2019Count || sst2019Count === 0 || !sstHistCount || sstHistCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (sst2019Mean === null || sst2019Mean === undefined || sstHistMean === null || sstHistMean === undefined || isNaN(sst2019Mean) || isNaN(sstHistMean)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for reasonable SST range (-2°C to 35°C) if (sst2019Mean < -2 || sst2019Mean > 35 || sstHistMean < -2 || sstHistMean > 35) { console.log('SST values out of reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Difference (2019 - Historical): ${(sst2019Mean - sstHistMean).toFixed(2)}°C`); if (sst2019Mean < sstHistMean) { console.log('August 2019 was cooler than 1985-2012 average.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('August 2019 was not cooler than 1985-2012 average.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
